title: Cannonball Adderley's 1956 band with Junior Mance and Jimmy Cobb
summary: Cannonball asks Sam into his band, but Junior Mance's nervous playing keeps it from gelling and the band breaks up when members drift off.

story.theme_name: Playing with and around Miles Davis
story.community_name: Playing with Miles Davis: joining, sessions and the band

blocks.x: And so he uh--and so after that, I went on to -- what band did I go to then? Oh, 1956--then "Cannonball" comes up from Florida.

I was gigging round town then, you know. Been playing little gigs, small time dances uptown and them little club dates and stuff. So Cannon come to town and wanted me to play in the band. And I--they had Junior Mance on the piano. Phew. And that was an experience. And JimmyCobb on the drums and myself, rhythm section. But the band--it was alright. We travelled around and the band never got off the ground. You know what I mean. Never could make no money, you know.
You say with Junior that was--would you say that was really--
Yeah. That was sort of an experience, man. So--
Well, you know, his--his style of playing the piano, man, was a, you know, we could never--we could never get nothing to go, you know, never gel.
Because his stuff was always the nervous type--like a rush type playing all the time.
And uh, so that was quite an experience there.
That's when I first met you.
Yeah, yeah. That band--we didn't--so that's when Cannon went to Miles' band. Everybody started went to--going to different band. I think Nat went to --
Woody Herman or J. J. somebody.*
